How to Pay Your Premium

Depending on how your policy is structured, you can pay directly to your insurance carrier or through our client portal.

Carrier Direct Bill

Most policies are billed directly by the insurance company. Pay instantly online, set up carrier AutoPay, or pay by phone with your carrier.

Notice Regarding Payment Due Dates & Grace Periods

Payment grace periods typically range from 10 to 30 days, but vary depending on the insurance carrier, policy type, and governing Florida regulations. Payments received after the expiration of a carrier's statutory grace period are subject to cancellation for non-payment, which may leave you without coverage or require reinstatement underwriting fees.

If you anticipate a billing difficulty or need to adjust your payment schedule, please contact our Tampa agency office at (813) 214-1731 or contact your carrier prior to your cancellation effective date.
